      directories:
        - src/presentation/**
      file_patterns:
        - src/presentation/**/*.ts
      roles:
        - controller
        - middleware
        - response
    - name: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/infrastructure/**
      file_patterns:
        - src/infrastructure/**/*.ts
      roles:
        - repository-impl
        - orm-entity
        - middleware
    - name: main
      directories:
        - src/main/**
      file_patterns:
        - src/main/**/*.ts
      roles:
        - factory
default_exclude_paths:
  - "node_modules/**"
